name: credit-memos-partial-en
query: The customer on invoice {credit_docnum} returned 1 x {credit_item}. Credit just that.
expected_behavior: Looks the invoice up by the DocNum the user gave
The proposed credit memo (CreditNotes) is copied from that invoice — the receipt references the source invoice and its line
Credits only the returned item with quantity 1, and none of the invoice's other lines or quantities
Shows a confirmation receipt and stops to ask the user to confirm before posting
